## Core Overview
- Course Code: AIC270 (Programming for Artificial Intelligence)
- Credit Hours: 3 (2 lecture, 1 lab)
- Prerequisite: CSC262 (Artificial Intelligence)
- Primary Purpose: Equip students with Python programming skills tailored for data analysis, machine learning foundations, object-oriented design, computer vision, and AI applications.

## Key Concepts & Topics
- Python Fundamentals: Integrated Development Environments, basic syntax, variables, expressions, operators, conditional loops, functions, file handling, exception handling, and debugging.
- Python Data Structures: Strings, lists, tuples, and dictionaries.
- Applied Mathematics for AI: Regression analysis and the chain rule.
- Object-Oriented Programming (OOP): Creating and using classes and objects for modular, scalable code.
- Data Analysis Libraries: Essential tools including NumPy, Pandas, and Matplotlib for numerical data analysis and visualization.
- Computer Vision: OpenCV, object tracking, and face/eye detection using Unit 5 techniques.
- Advanced Applications: AI-based games, deep learning applications, and version control using Git and Subversion.

## Exam Takeaways & High-Yield Areas
- CLO-1 (Applying): Master fundamental Python programming constructs to solve basic computational problems (Units 1-2).
- CLO-2 (Understanding): Know how to design and use classes and objects following object-oriented principles (Units 2-4).
- CLO-3 (Understanding): Grasp deep learning techniques and AI application building (Unit 5).
- CLO-4 (Applying): Implement practical AI-based applications, computer vision tasks, and optimization techniques using Python (Units 1-6).
- Primary Textbook: Artificial Intelligence with Python: Your complete guide to building intelligent apps using Python 3.x by Artasanchez and Joshi (2020).
